title: Vision of a rocket exploding at launch
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Vision of a rocket exploding at launch, about early 1990s at Base C-van; possibly Chinese launch, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: one time I I saw um a missile um uh being launched

plain: A former US Air Force sergeant, Dan Sherman, says that in the early 1990s, while on duty in a communications van at his base, he once saw a missile being launched, as a vision in his mind, and saw it explode. He thinks it may have been a Chinese launch, and he tells the story in his book, Above Black. If true, it would mean he could perceive distant events with no ordinary means.
